basics.name: Jonathan Geuter
basics.summary: PhD student in Applied Mathematics at Harvard. Passionate about statistical machine learning, deep learning, and algorithm design, particularly in the areas of language models, test-time scaling, alignment, novel architectures (such as masked diffusion models), diffusion models, and optimal transport. Kempner Graduate Fellow at the Kempner Institute for the Study of Natural & Artificial Intelligence.
